name: Do I need to do any preparation before the paint and finish crew arrives?

mainEntity.name: Do I need to do any preparation before the paint and finish crew arrives?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, some preparation on your part helps ensure a smooth and efficient project. For interior work, we ask that you clear furniture away from walls, remove valuables, and take down wall hangings. For exterior jobs, please ensure landscaping is trimmed back from the house and any items near the foundation are moved. While our crew will handle covering floors and protecting surfaces, these steps help us begin work promptly. We provide a detailed checklist after project confirmation.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, clear furniture and valuables for interiors, and trim landscaping for exteriors. A checklist will be provided to help you prepare.
